Insurgency Revisited - Feels More Real Than Other Shooters

I don't know how to feel about insurgency. It's more immersive in terms of realism than Battlefield or Call of Duty of course, but as a whole it isn't as immersive as I imagined.

People tend to rush into objectives, and the maps are so small (with only a couple of choke points) that there's little room for manoeuvring, or any kind of competent strategy. This, combined with how quickly you can respawn and die, limits your ability to use tactics as a squad.

It's a fun shooter, but it's hardly a revolutionary tactical squad based shooter because of the size of the maps, and the pacing of the game.

I agree, Insurgency is a fantastic game. Very difficult, very team focused!
